Nina P: hey folks, first week question. i'm about to open my first PR changing default batching in packages/serve. lint CI caught a few things and i have minor runtime type loosening. what's the recommended approach for a new hire: fix everything now, or can i add small TODOs and file follow-ups?

Alex H: welcome Nina! for small changes please fix lint and minor types in the same PR. if it grows to touching many files, split it. TODOs are okay but link a tracking issue.

Nina P: cool. also what's our branch naming standard? i saw `feat/` and `eng/` in other repos.

Sahil G: for infra/runtime work we use `eng/runtime/<short-kebab>` or `fix/runtime/...`. include ticket id at start if available, e.g., `ENG-5012-eng/runtime-default-batcher`. keep it under ~60 chars.

Nina P: thanks. tiny process Q: do reviewers prefer I squash commits before opening the PR?

Alex H: no need to squash before opening. keep intermediate commits informative while iterating. we'll typically squash-and-merge for a single logical change. if your commits represent distinct steps (tests, refactor, fix), keep them and explain in the PR.

CI Bot: Lint job failed: packages/serve/src/batcher.ts:34:5 - unexpected any. See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/1923459999/jobs/8

Nina P: the `any` is from a third-party helper. I'll add a narrow wrapper type and a `// TODO: refine` with an issue link.

Sahil G: perfect. one small note: add a short "How to test locally" section in the PR body with exact commands, it speeds reviews.

Nina P: will do. tagging @Alex H as reviewer once it's up. thanks! :raised_hands:

Alex H: ping me after CI is green, happy to review and share a tiny harness for perf checks.

Nina P: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/22. Reviewer: @Alex H
